archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) combined with Archetype 4 (Swiss/Brutalist). Premium Linear/Vercel SaaS aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first layouts since this is an Expo mobile app target. Ensure screen bounds are controlled and scrollable areas are well-defined without triggering window scroll if unnecessary.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use generous padding. Cards should use p-5 or p-6.
spacing_and_layout.bottom_sheet: Rounded top corners (rounded-t-3xl). Max height ~75vh. Should overlap content beautifully with a subtle dark backdrop blur.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style layouts for library cards. Asymmetric sizing where possible.

components.bottom_tab_bar: Fixed to bottom (inset-x-0 bottom-0). h-20. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050508]/85 border-t border-white/5. Icons scale up slightly when active and tint to #7c50ff.
components.bottom_sheet: Use Shadcn Drawer (vaul). bg-[#111115] border-t border-white/10. Include handle bar. Must display: Term (h2, #7c50ff), Definition (body text in Italian), Domain Badge (pill shape with 1px border), and 'Cosa dire' (What to say) phrase inside a subtle highlighted box (bg-[#7c50ff]/10 border border-[#7c50ff]/20).
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#7c50ff] hover:bg-[#6a42df] text-white rounded-xl py-4 font-semibold text-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-[0.98] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(124,80,255,0.25)].
components.cards: bg-[#111115] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-white/10 transition-colors
components.real_time_subtitles: Display as a list or stream of words. Words flow upwards. Clickable words must wrap nicely. Hover/Press state flashes #7c50ff.

interactions_and_motion.drawer_swipe: Framer motion drag-to-close behavior (built into Vaul drawer).
interactions_and_motion.word_click: When a word is tapped, subtle scale down and highlight in #7c50ff.
interactions_and_motion.micro_animations: Smooth springs for tab bar transitions. Page transitions using Framer Motion (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).

pages.Auth: Show stylized 'C' logo. Background image `auth_background`. Inputs for email/password. 'Start 7-Day Trial' primary button. Text noting Stripe €9/month Pro subscription.
pages.Home: Recent saved words, quick jump to Online or Live modes. Usage stats.
pages.Online Mode: Full screen scrolling text (like a chat interface where words flow from bottom). Microphone active indicator. Tappable words.
pages.Live Mode: Large typography. Dedicated landscape-mode friendly layout. Central 'Ascolta' (Listen) pulse button to start.
pages.Library: Saved words. Grid of domain-colored cards. Search bar. Swipe to delete.
pages.Settings: Manage Pro subscription (Stripe), multi-language settings (Italian default), account info.

media_urls.description: Dark premium ambient background for Auth/Login screen

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='tab-home', data-testid='word-clickable').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast against #050508. Use #FFFFFF for primary text, #A1A1AA for secondary text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a mobile-web layout using React and Tailwind CSS.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide for premium vector iconography.
Implement the Bottom Sheet using Shadcn 'Drawer' (vaul) or Framer Motion.
Use mock data for the subtitles to demonstrate the scrolling chat-like text with clickable words.
Apply Linear/Vercel styling strictly: deep blacks (#050508), soft inner card highlights (1px border-white/5), no chunky shadows. Rely on subtle #7c50ff glows.
Make sure 'Cosa dire' phrase in Bottom Sheet stands out effectively.
Use data-testid on all key interactive elements as per the testing rules.
